nuvira.description: Multi-agent AI coding assistant — plan, write, review, test, and publish code with local or cloud AI models
nuvira.capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces: Agent-Nuvira reads workspace files as context for agent runs and can write proposed changes. In a restricted workspace, workspace contents are treated as untrusted; run agents only in folders you trust.
nuvira.capabilities.virtualWorkspaces: Agent-Nuvira needs a filesystem workspace to scan context and apply changes.

nuvira.config.defaultProvider: Default AI provider to use (overrides config file). Leave empty to use the configured default.
nuvira.config.defaultModel: Default model to use (overrides config file). Leave empty to use the configured default.
nuvira.config.autoApplyChanges: Automatically apply changes suggested by agents without previewing diffs.
nuvira.config.showProgressPanel: Automatically show the agent progress panel when an agent task starts.
nuvira.config.useAutoRouting: Let the agent pick the best provider/model for each task (Auto model routing). Overrides defaultProvider/defaultModel for chat and execute.

nuvira.walkthrough.description: Set up the CLI and run your first multi-agent goal without leaving the editor.
nuvira.walkthrough.installCli.title: Install the Agent-Nuvira CLI
nuvira.walkthrough.installCli.descriptio:
The extension drives the `agent-nuvira` CLI as a child process. Install it once:

```bash
npm install -g agent-nuvira
```

Already installed? Point the extension at it with the `agent-nuvira.cliPath` setting (for example `npx agent-nuvira`).
nuvira.walkthrough.configureProvider.des: Pick a provider and model — local (Ollama) or cloud (Groq, Gemini, OpenRouter and more). [Switch model / provider](command:agent-nuvira.switchModel) opens the picker, or enable Auto routing to let the agent choose per task.
nuvira.walkthrough.runGoal.title: Run your first goal
nuvira.walkthrough.runGoal.description: Give the agent a task in plain language and watch the specialized agents collaborate in the progress panel. [Execute a goal](command:agent-nuvira.executeGoal).
nuvira.walkthrough.openChat.title: Chat with your codebase
nuvira.walkthrough.openChat.description: Ask questions, request fixes, and review proposed changes in the chat panel. [Open chat](command:agent-nuvira.openChat).
